overview_description.description: AFS offers a safe, secure, effective, and dependable management solution. AFS, which is equipped with the most recent IBM mainframe system, employs a cutting-edge backup and redundant storage system, as well as a fully working offshore disaster recovery center. AFS offers BPay, a digital wallet solution that allows individuals, businesses, and corporations to make and receive payments using their smartphones instead of cash or cards in an easy, fast, and secure manner. BPay exists to be the go-to app for digital payments, commerce, and financial services.

product.name: Card issuing & processing
product.description: A bank card operations solution covering card issuance, transaction processing, card program management, and related operational support.

product.name: Fraud & risk management
product.description: Fraud detection, risk management, authentication, and managed fraud services for protecting payment transactions and financial customers.

product.name: Payment gateway
product.description: A payment acceptance service that enables businesses to process online payments and connect customer transactions with acquiring and payment infrastructure.

product.name: POS terminals
product.description: Point-of-sale payment terminals that allow businesses to accept card and other electronic payments at physical merchant locations.

product.name: Open banking
product.description: Secure, compliant APIs for sharing financial data and enabling connected financial services and customer experiences.

product.name: Value added services
product.description: Additional payment, security, and service capabilities that extend the functionality of payment products for banks and businesses.
